title: Discriminating confidence tier: option-distance and existing signals (free), optional second sample with permuted options, measurement by confidence group (REQ-0079)
acceptance_criteria: AC2 implemented tests-first, measured on the scored DGNL answers with Wilson intervals, paid checks inside caps

design.summary: separate confidence tier beside the status; free negative signals (option distance, existing signals, alternative reading named by the solver); optional second sample with permuted options on no_independent_check and doubt ids; measurement by confidence group with Wilson intervals

implementation.summary: free slice: verifier.option_distance, core/decision.confidence tier (separate field, PASS bar unchanged, negative signals incl. a named alternative reading), metrics by_confidence with Wilson interval, flag --confidence default off; second sample (75.2) waits for the paid approval

unit_test.result: 1460 tests, only the 4 known baseline failures; default-off output byte-identical to e90202d; second-sample mapping correct (option-text mock: all agree; letter mock: all differ; compared in original letters); caps correct (stop mid-way gives second_skipped, never second_differs); 8+7 mutations killed; tester D1 D4 D5 D6 fixed; free replay: signals alone do not separate (0 of 4 real wrong answers caught)
